exam_scheme.note: The Banaras Hindu University Postgraduate Entrance Test (BHU PET) was the dedicated institutional entrance exam conducted for admission to postgraduate master's degree programmes across Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Varanasi. In accordance with the Ministry of Education policy, BHU now conducts all postgraduate admissions through the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduates (CUET-PG) administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA). Candidates select domain-specific paper codes (such as COQP, SCQP, HUQP, LAQP, and ACQP) corresponding to their intended master's discipline (M.A., M.Sc., M.Com., LL.M., MCA, M.Tech., and M.Sc. Agriculture). Each test comprises 75 domain-specific multiple-choice questions (300 marks) administered in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode of 105 minutes duration. Marking scheme: 4 marks awarded for each correct response, negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect response (-1), and 0 marks for unattempted questions. Candidates register separately on the BHU Central Admission Portal (CAP PG) for seat allotment based on CUET-PG scores.
